items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; short taps ~0.25-0.4s nudge, holds 1-2s cover real distance (~2s hold shifts world ~100px, character stays screen-center). Space = Do Action (contextual pick). LMB hovers/selects; hover shows verb label. Escape = Paused menu. Tab = map. Craft UI does NOT pause time — torch durability and night damage tick while menus are open.

PICKING: 'Pick X' verb only appears when close and roughly same y as target; distant hover shows 'Examine X'. Space with only 'Examine' fails silently. Standing on target flips to Examine; step back a fraction. Aim at the target's own bright pixels — tree trunks steal hover ('Examine Evergreen') over tufts at bases, which repeatedly wasted time this run. Confirmed yields: sapling -> Twigs; golden/dry open-ground or grass-fringe tuft -> Cut Grass; small yellow flower -> Petals. Each pick removes the plant; picked saplings appeared to respawn (new bare saplings seen after harvest).

VERBLESS TARGETS = SCENERY, skip: small ground sprigs, loose twig-like ground items, butterflies/flying creatures (red and brown birds, harvester bird — scenery/critters, not pickable). No feedback means don't act.

CRAFT UI: Left sidebar icons at x~0.019: axe/tools ~y0.114, flame 'Light' ~y0.197. Clicking flame opens vertical recipe column x~0.05-0.15, rows at y~0.13,0.22,0.30,0.375,0.45,... Hover a row's CENTER (x~0.10) to open right detail panel with name, costs as have/need, description, Build button ~(0.28,0.66). Dark tiles = unaffordable silhouettes (still hoverable); bright = affordable. Build sometimes needs a second click. Known: Torch = 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs ('A portable light source'); Campfire = 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit = rocks + 12 of unidentified material.

TORCH: Crafting puts it in hand with % durability (~96% start) draining fast (~12% per action cycle); burned out in ~8 actions. Lit torch wasted in daylight. Craft spares before dusk, not at dusk.

NIGHT: dusk warning 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' then near-total blackness ('It's so dark!'), damage 'OW! Something hit me!' until death. Daylight-holding-torch survived Night 1 before. Blue circular icon appears beside the Day clock at night (function unknown; seen appearing in this run before darkness).

HUNGER: 'I'm so hungry!' warning seen. Berries from red-berried bushes (mechanism unconfirmed); Petals hover shows 'Eat'. Food mechanics unresolved.

HOTBAR: slots fill in acquisition order; hover slot icon to read name/count (slot1 label ~x0.135, slot2 ~0.20, ~0.07 spacing, y~0.93). CRITICAL: green icons are not all Cut Grass — some are Petals; always hover-verify counts before crafting (a miscount ended a prior run).

THIS RUN STATE AT SUMMARY: Day 1, hotbar = Twigs x2 (slot1) + Cut Grass x1 (slot2) — one grass short of the assumed torch cost. Darkness hit at Day 1 with blue moon icon; opened Light category; first/affordable bright row at ~y0.14 was hovered to read the true torch cost (was checking whether only 1 Cut Grass is needed). Unresolved: exact torch cost vs. current 1-grass inventory; whether torch can be afforded at all tonight.

FAILED/WASTEFUL STRATEGIES: click-to-harvest; Space from far range; standing on target; hovering trunks instead of tuft tips; chasing tufts occluded by pine trunks (spent much of this run on 3+ such tufts — abandon after 2-3 tries); treating ground twigs/sprigs as pickable; clicking recipe tile edges; leaving crafting until dusk; assuming all green hotbar icons are Cut Grass; wandering in darkness.

LESSONS: daylight is a hard deadline — gather immediately, verify counts, craft well before dusk. Only adjacent, same-y, 'Pick'-verified Space presses harvest. Night without a lit torch is fatal. Open questions: berries/petals as food; the bottom bright recipe tile's identity; recipe column scrolling; blue night icon; recipes unlocked by new materials (logs/rocks).
